prompts.name: milestones
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: individual illustration for a working dashboard's vintage educational vocabulary flashcard. A charming authentic 1950s printed picture dictionary illustration: bold simplified hand-cut silhouettes, 3 or 4 flat opaque ink colors, slightly uneven hand-painted edges, visible subtle dry ink and paper grain INSIDE the object, naive geometric drawing with deliberate composition. Not photoreal, not 3D, no modern UI icon, no gradients, no realistic lighting, no drop shadow. Orthographic face-on view. Single central motif fills 70 percent of a wide landscape 4:3 canvas, fully visible with clear margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT background outside the motif, no paper rectangle, no border, no lettering, no captions, no numbers, no watermark. Muted vermilion, butter cream, dark charcoal green, muted indigo and warm golden yellow palette. A butter-yellow round vintage alarm clock with two little bells and two feet, dark charcoal-green hands and simple tick marks without numerals, red hand accent. Readable circular silhouette.
